correctness.rationale: For nonempty proper B⊂[n], the literal Alexandrov downset difference is Ψ_x(B)=2^|B|−2^|B∩x|. With atom x={1}, filtration stages alternate contractible root cones with (j−1)-skeleta of an (n−1)-simplex: C(n−1,j) reduced classes in degree j−1 are born at 2^j−1 and die at 2^(j+1)−2 for 1≤j≤n−2, followed by essential H_{n−2} at 2^(n−1)−1 and one essential H0 from t=0. With coatom x=[n]\{1}, each threshold 2^k glues a cone on the (k−1)-skeleton of an (n−2)-simplex to its full simplex, giving C(n−2,k) reduced H_k bars [2^k,2^(k+1)) for 0≤k≤n−3, then essential H_{n−2} at 2^(n−2), plus the essential H0. Naturality of barycentric subdivision and adjacent stages establishes inclusion maps, not only stagewise ranks; standard skeleton collapse is integral, so valid over every coefficient field.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks do not prove the all-parameter claims; analytic arguments or exhaustive certificates are required.
